purpose: Create a scientifically correct 100-parent recipe-stratified topology manifest from the sealed V2 graph/spline candidates without generating or modifying topology.

approval.scope: One read-only V2R reclassification and split-manifest audit over 120 sealed V2 candidates; zero topology generation, mesh, LiDAR, labels or training.
approval.confirmation_reference: User replied 继续干 after receiving the exact zero-generation, read-only recipe-reclassification, fixed C01-C10, 100-parent/80-10-10 and zero mesh/LiDAR/training V2R scope.

source.mutation_policy: Source run and all graph/spline artifacts are read-only and must not be rewritten.

selection.cycle_policy: requested connector count is recipe metadata; actual graph cycle rank is GT metadata and must be >= requested connector count, not equal.

leakage_controls: Selection is fixed by candidate ID C01-C10 and does not optimize actual cycle rank.
Only already reviewed rank-1 train previews may be referenced; no validation/development-test map rendering or inspection.
All future geometry, trajectory and observations inherit the frozen parent split.
next_stage_boundary: PASS freezes 100 topology parent identities and a development split only. Perception mesh generation requires a separate proposal and approval.
